counting_note: Original F1-F10 IDs are preserved. R2-001..R2-010 are the prior-round new findings. R3-001..R3-008 are residual/new defects found in this round. A disposition of FIXED is limited to the stated subparts and never implies live acceptance.

original_findings.title: PASS with blocking findings must not advance Gate A
original_findings.observed: parseAgentOutput rejects PASS with any finding, APPROVE_WITH_COMMENTS with non-LOW findings, invalid verdicts, empty summaries and non-string findings; verdict helpers PASS/PAUSE are consistent. No regression.
original_findings.residual: Free-text severity detection remains prefix-based; real Reviewer output is not exercised.

original_findings.title: Any two seats, optional preflight, third-seat window, cancellation and lost ACK
original_findings.residual: Real SSH/P0 was not contacted. Lost ACK leaves acknowledged jobs and NEEDS_RECONCILIATION; it is not proof every remote job stopped.

original_findings.title: Duplicate HMAC key bytes and physical identity
original_findings.residual: HMAC authenticates possession of configured keys; physicalId is a management-side claim, not hardware attestation.

original_findings.title: Paseo waitForFinish numeric timeout call shape
original_findings.observed: The adapter passes numeric 3600000 to a SDK-shaped stub. Real SDK/daemon timeout and disconnection remain NOT_VERIFIED.

original_findings.title: Historical Soul, verdict and legal deliverable contract
original_findings.residual: All 11 Soul blobs match provenance, but 6 Soul files still contain legacy APPROVE/REQUEST_CHANGES/Pro-Audit text. No Controller-side legal Markdown deliverable mapping exists.

original_findings.title: Windows OS boundary and TEST_ONLY add/review/merge
original_findings.observed: Only the provider-permission matrix and offline fixtures were exercised. No Windows SID/ACL/network/Job Object proof, no TEST_ONLY new-test incorporation, no real SDK or remote Harness acceptance.

original_findings.title: SQLite transactions, dispatch summary and evidence hash chain
original_findings.residual: Store.event() itself performs no verify and no transaction; p0.mjs:72 calls it directly. An attacker or a crash-recovery path can append an event that re-anchors a tampered state. The unkeyed local chain still cannot resist a privileged full-ledger rewrite.

original_findings.title: Compliance stop and human recovery
original_findings.residual: A preflight failure on a task whose stage is not TERMINAL overwrites status NEEDS_RECONCILIATION with BLOCKED, losing the reconciliation context.

original_findings.title: Child-process environment and raw-log Secret boundary
original_findings.residual: The synthetic sentinel is filtered for Git/Harness. taskkill and the Popen execute worker still inherit the full parent environment. Raw model output is persisted without redaction; Windows ACL is unverified.

original_findings.title: Query, Git/worktree and process lifecycle side effects
original_findings.residual: Read-only WAL access still creates persistent -wal/-shm side files (main DB bytes unchanged). Windows Job Object / full process-tree termination is not verified.

r2_findings.title: Preflight re-anchoring fixed for five entries, but Store.event() remains an unverified re-anchor write path
r2_findings.observed: Tampering aRound (10->0), bRound (9->0), status, stage, history or frozen policy is rejected by run, approve, recover, artifact, recordIntent, recordAck and recordTerminal; corrupt state stays detected and 10+10 budgets remain consumed after controlled recovery. However Store.event() has no verify and no transaction, and p0.mjs:72 calls it directly. After tampering aRound=0/bRound=0, one store.event() call makes verify() accept the tampered state (budget reset).
r2_findings.residual: This is a re-anchor write path reachable from production code. It requires local state corruption or a hostile in-process caller, but it defeats the stated R2-001 invariant.
r2_findings.minimal_fix: Make Store.event() private/asserting: run verify() and wrap in a transaction, or remove the direct p0.mjs call and route it through a verified save. Add a regression test that every public write method rejects a tampered ledger.

r2_findings.title: Artifact registration failure, orphans, same-name retry and directory anomalies fail closed
r2_findings.observed: An injected ARTIFACT_REGISTERED failure leaves an orphan file; verify() rejects it as unregistered; same-name retry is rejected; a regular file in place of the evidence directory, a subdirectory, a missing registered artifact and an altered artifact all fail closed. No automatic repair API exists.
r2_findings.residual: Detection-only mitigation; no crash-recovery protocol. Orphans require manual reconciliation and are never silently deleted.

r2_findings.title: inspect() reads one consistent SQLite snapshot
r2_findings.observed: With two real SQLite connections and a deterministic concurrent writer, readSnapshot sees the old aRound while the writer commits a new one; the post-snapshot read sees the new value; verification inside the snapshot uses the same version; rollback on failure is clean.

r2_findings.title: Read-only WAL access side files are documented
r2_findings.observed: Opening an existing WAL database read-only creates and retains workflow.sqlite-wal and workflow.sqlite-shm; the main database bytes are unchanged (SHA-256 equal before/after). The remediation document discloses this and deliberately does not use immutable=1 on a live WAL database.
r2_findings.residual: Filesystem side effect remains by design.

r2_findings.title: Minimal environment is enforced for Git helpers and Harness, but not for every child process
r2_findings.observed: Node childEnv and Python child_env filter a synthetic unrelated secret; the remote run() wrapper and the Harness subprocess use the allowlist; valid envAllowList entries pass and invalid names are rejected. However git.mjs:20 spawns taskkill without childEnv, and p0_runner.py:304 spawns the execute worker via Popen without env, inheriting the full runner environment.
r2_findings.residual: taskkill and the execute worker are not Git helpers or the paid Harness, so the original R2-005 defect (remote Git helper inheriting secrets) is fixed. The remaining inheritance is a defense-in-depth gap and should be closed.
r2_findings.minimal_fix: Pass env:childEnv() to the taskkill spawn and env=child_env(config) to the Popen execute worker.

r2_findings.title: Parser compatibility fixed; approved Soul migration and deliverable mapping still absent
r2_findings.observed: Local Markdown+bare JSON, fenced JSON, CRLF, legacy APPROVE/REQUEST_CHANGES, PASS+BLOCKER and APPROVE_WITH_COMMENTS severity gates all behave correctly. Remote Markdown+bare/fenced JSON and legacy verdicts normalize; PASS with any finding becomes FAIL. Indented JSON after Markdown is rejected locally and becomes QUESTION remotely (conservative). All 11 Soul blobs match provenance, but 6 Souls still carry legacy verdict/Pro-Audit text and no legal Markdown/JSON deliverable mapping exists.
r2_findings.residual: Parser compatibility is not Soul approval. The V2.1 migration remains unapproved; output contract still lacks task_id/role/phase/commit/Soul SHA/legal Markdown/raw test receipts.

r2_findings.title: Original Python suite is green on the actual Windows host
r2_findings.observed: python -B -m unittest discover -s remote/tests -p 'test*.py' -v ran 4 tests, 4 passed, exit 0, with no WinError 87 / status failure / temporary-directory cleanup error in stderr. process_alive returns true for self, false for a dead pid, false for a nonexistent pid, and does not crash for PID 4 (no permission => false). status QUEUED/RUNNING/FINISHED/CANCELLED/CANCEL_REQUESTED/UNKNOWN paths were exercised; cancel on Windows returns CANCEL_UNCERTAIN.
r2_findings.residual: Real Linux Runner acceptance, process-group zero-residual and 600-second timing remain NOT_VERIFIED. process_alive proves liveness, not ownership.

r2_findings.title: Pre-commit BLOCKED recovery is available through an explicit frozen basis
r2_findings.observed: A pre-spec BLOCKED task recovers to PLANNER with frozen.digest; a post-spec pre-worktree task recovers to PREPARE with taskSpecSha; a post-worktree task recovers to A_WORKER; wrong basis, an invented Git SHA, an outstanding dispatch, a corrupted ledger and a non-BLOCKED task are all rejected. The CLI --basis path succeeds end-to-end and fails closed without/with a wrong basis.
r2_findings.residual: authorizeRecovery compares the basis string only and does not re-hash the frozen object; combined with the Store.event() re-anchor path it accepts a forged frozen digest (R3-002). The later live preflight still rejects the forged config.

r2_findings.title: Most sensitive-path checks fixed, but leading-space filenames still bypass and are committed
r2_findings.observed: Tracked .env edits, untracked .env, .env.production, both rename directions, copy to .env.production, nested sub/.env, uppercase .ENV, .envrc, *.pem, id_rsa, id_ed25519, pre-staged sensitive paths and malformed porcelain records are all rejected. A filename with a leading space (' .env' and 'sub/ .env') does NOT match SENSITIVE_PATH, is returned by porcelainPaths, passes safeChange, and commitWorktree commits it as .env. A trailing-space name could not be added by git on Windows.
r2_findings.residual: Confirms the user-requested leading-space probe still results in a sensitive path being committed to a local disposable repository. No remote and only synthetic content were used.
r2_findings.minimal_fix: Normalize/trim each path component before matching (and reject any path whose basename differs from its trimmed form), or use git check-ignore / explicit basename deny-list on the normalized name. Add leading/trailing-space regression tests.

r2_findings.title: Successful reviewer evidence is preserved; reconciliation status can still be overwritten by a later preflight
r2_findings.observed: With the real PaseoAgentRuntime and an in-process fake SDK, one success + one provider loss preserves the successful seat artifact (role/agentId/verdict/summary/findings/raw), history entry and evidence hash; the failed seat's dispatch remains ACKNOWLEDGED; a second run does not redispatch either seat. Both-success records two artifacts and two TERMINAL dispatches. Duplicate Agent IDs are recorded then fail closed. However a run on the NEEDS_RECONCILIATION task with the live flags unset overwrites status/stage with BLOCKED (R3-003).
r2_findings.residual: Evidence preservation is fixed. The reconciliation-context loss is a separate state-machine defect.

residual_findings.title: Store.event() has no verify/transaction and is called directly from p0.mjs, re-anchoring tampered state and resetting the 10+10 budget
residual_findings.repro: Init a task with aRound=10/bRound=9; UPDATE tasks SET data with aRound=0/bRound=0; verify() rejects; call store.event(id,'P0_OPTIONAL_NOT_DISPATCHED',{...}); verify() now accepts; aRound=0/bRound=0.
residual_findings.impact: Any production path that calls Store.event() (p0.mjs probe-skip) or any future caller can turn a detected tamper into a trusted ledger head and restore exhausted Gate A/B budget.
residual_findings.minimal_fix: Add verify() + transaction inside Store.event() or make it a private helper; replace p0.mjs's direct call with a verified store method.

residual_findings.title: authorizeRecovery does not re-hash the frozen config before accepting it as recovery basis
residual_findings.repro: Tamper frozen.intent without touching frozen.digest; re-anchor via store.event(); authorizeRecovery with expectedBasis=frozen.digest succeeds and moves to PLANNER.
residual_findings.impact: A forged frozen digest is accepted as a trusted recovery basis. A later live preflight rejects the forged config, so this is not a direct execution bypass, but it writes a HUMAN_CONTROLLED_RECOVERY event on a forged basis.
residual_findings.minimal_fix: Assert frozen.digest === sha256(frozen without digest) at the top of authorizeRecovery, sharing the livePreflight check.

residual_findings.title: run() preflight failure overwrites status NEEDS_RECONCILIATION with BLOCKED when stage is not TERMINAL
residual_findings.repro: Create a review-pair failure (status=NEEDS_RECONCILIATION, stage=A_REVIEW); call run() with P1_LIVE_ALLOWED unset; observe status=BLOCKED, stage=BLOCKED and pendingHuman replaced by 'Preflight failed: live dispatch disabled...'.
residual_findings.impact: The reconciliation context and the original failure reason are lost; an operator may see BLOCKED instead of 'concurrent reviewer execution uncertain'. Outstanding ACKNOWLEDGED dispatches still block recovery, so this is not an execution bypass.
residual_findings.minimal_fix: In the preflight catch, do not mutate a task whose status is NEEDS_RECONCILIATION or whose inflight is set; only seal BLOCKED from an otherwise READY/WAITING stage.

residual_findings.title: Windows taskkill helper inherits the full parent environment
residual_findings.impact: Defense-in-depth gap; taskkill does not forward the environment, but it is outside the stated minimal-environment policy.
residual_findings.minimal_fix: Add env:childEnv() to the taskkill spawn.

residual_findings.title: Remote Popen execute worker inherits the full runner environment
residual_findings.repro: Static: subprocess.Popen([...], stdin=..., stdout=..., stderr=..., start_new_session=True) has no env argument.
residual_findings.impact: The execute worker itself sees the full runner environment; it does filter the Harness and Git helpers with child_env. Defense-in-depth gap.
residual_findings.minimal_fix: Pass env=child_env(config) to the Popen execute worker.

residual_findings.title: CLI usage contains a literal backslash-n instead of a newline
residual_findings.observed: The recover usage line prints 'EXACT_COMMIT\n  recover ...' literally.
residual_findings.minimal_fix: Replace '\\n' with a real newline in the template string.

residual_findings.title: APPROVE_WITH_COMMENTS handling differs between local and remote parsers
residual_findings.observed: Local APPROVE_WITH_COMMENTS with only LOW/INFO findings is accepted; the remote parser downgrades APPROVE_WITH_COMMENTS with ANY finding to FAIL.
residual_findings.impact: Conservative but inconsistent; a low-severity comment can change the cross-seat outcome depending on which boundary parses it.
residual_findings.minimal_fix: Use the same severity gate at both boundaries or document the remote stricter rule as intentional.

residual_findings.title: Indented final JSON after Markdown is rejected (local throw / remote QUESTION)
residual_findings.observed: A final JSON object indented by two spaces after a Markdown report fails both parsers; multi-line pretty JSON at column 0 is accepted remotely.
residual_findings.impact: Conservative fail-closed; may misclassify a legitimate model output and force manual reconciliation.
residual_findings.minimal_fix: Accept a final brace-delimited object with optional leading whitespace, and require it to be the last non-whitespace content.

mandatory_unverified: Windows distinct process identity/SID, file ACL and network boundary
TEST_ONLY newly added tests, independent review and merge into final commit
Real Paseo SDK/daemon authentication, timeout, disconnection and Agent lifecycle
Real remote OpenCode JSONL, permissions and job lifecycle
Two different physical P0 hosts and trusted host/key mapping
Real 600-second third-seat grace and Linux/Windows process-group/Job Object cancellation
OS crash/power-loss and sustained multi-process SQLite stress
External immutable evidence anchor and approval-principal authentication
Windows symlink (120000) and gitlink (160000) commit rejection could not be executed due to host permissions
